page.heading: Skills
page.subtitle: Reusable instruction blocks. Attach them to agents in the order they should appear in the prompt.

empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Create a skill from scratch, or import one from a Markdown file or a zip archive.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to preview its body.

card.deleteConfirm: Delete skill "{name}"? Every agent using it loses that prompt block. This cannot be undone.
card.agentCount: {count, plural, =0 {no agents} one {# agent} other {# agents}}

create.title: Create a skill
create.subtitle: Name it, say when it applies, and write the rule

editor.title: Configuration
editor.descriptionHint: This is the skill's interface — write it directively, e.g. "Use when reviewing tests for uncovered branches."
editor.bodyHint: Rendered into the prompt as its own block. Saving a changed body creates a new version.
editor.usedBy: Used by {count, plural, =0 {no agents} one {# agent} other {# agents}}
editor.severityHint: State the severity a finding from this skill should carry — an unstated severity defaults to CRITICAL.
editor.previewSubtitle: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.
editor.versionMessageHint: Recorded against the new version, so the history reads like a changelog. Optional.
editor.versionsSubtitle: Every save snapshots the body so eval runs stay reproducible against the exact text they scored.

drawer.title: Import a skill
drawer.subtitle: Import from a file, a URL, or search vetted community skills
drawer.fileSubtitle: Upload a Markdown file or a zip archive. Nothing is saved until you confirm.

file.nameHint: Taken from the file's frontmatter or first heading — edit it if you like.
file.pickHint: Markdown (.md) or archive (.zip). Only the skill's Markdown is read.
file.trustNotice: An imported body becomes INSTRUCTIONS inside your agent's prompt — this is someone else's text steering your review. Read it before you enable it. The skill is created disabled.
file.bodyHint: This text is added to the agent's prompt as instructions. Import leaves the skill disabled until you vet it.
file.success: Imported "{name}" — disabled until you vet and enable it.

url.label: Skill URL
url.hint: Fetched server-side and left disabled until vetted. Its body becomes instructions in the agent's prompt.
url.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.

preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from outside the workspace. Its body is injected into the agent's prompt as instructions — vet it before enabling it.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.

agentTab.orderHint: Order matters — earlier skills appear earlier in the assembled prompt. Drag to reorder.
agentTab.empty: No skills in the library yet.

stats.noAgents: Not attached to any agent yet.
stats.noFindings: No findings attributed to this skill yet.
stats.attributionCaveat: Findings are attributed by the model and kept only when the skill was actually in that run's prompt. {count, plural, =0 {No findings from runs using this skill are unattributed.} one {# finding from a run using this skill could not be attributed to any skill.} other {# findings from runs using this skill could not be attributed to any skill.}}

evals.runDisabled: Skill evals arrive in a later lesson.
evals.emptyBody: Evals for a skill arrive in a later lesson. The eval tables are reserved, not missing.
